mapper.select: SELECT 'DR' AS recordType , B.COMN_CD_NM AS itemType , C.MDFM_NM AS itemNm , A.MDF_REC_DTM AS writingDate , A.WRTR_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd , (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.WRTR_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm , A.WRT_STF_NO AS writerStfNo , (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.WRT_STF_NO) AS writerNm , 'DR_' || A.MDFM_CLS_CD || '_' || A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD || '_' || A.MDRC_ID || '_' || A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS keyId , A.MDRC_ID AS mdrcId , CASE WHEN MDRC_WRT_STS_CD IN ('11', '12') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS mdrcWrtStsCd , CASE WHEN MDRC_WRT_STS_CD IN ('11', '12') THEN A.MDRC_ID || '_' || A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ END AS dgnsRerRcdcNo , NVL((SELECT MAX('Y') FROM ODS.S_MRDDREPG Z WHERE Z.MDRC_ID = A.MDRC_ID AND Z.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AND PRNT_YN = 'Y'), 'N') AS prntYn , DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급') AS pactTpCd , A.HSP_TP_CD AS hspTpCd , A.PT_NO AS ptNo FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECM A , ODS.S_CCCCCSTE B , ODS.S_MRFMFORM C WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.MDRC_DC_TP_CD = 'C' AND A.MDFM_CLS_CD IN ('D009', 'D035') AND B.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' AND B.COMN_CD = A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD AND C.MDFM_CLS_CD = A.MDFM_CLS_CD AND C.MDFM_ID = A.MDFM_ID AND C.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ ORDER BY REC_DTM DESC

SELECT T.RECORD_TYPE AS recordType , T.RECORD_DETAIL_TYPE AS recordDetailType , CASE WHEN T.RECORD_TYPE = 'DR' THEN COMN.COMN_CD_NM ELSE T.ITEM_TYPE END AS itemType , CASE WHEN T.RECORD_TYPE = 'DR' THEN COMN.COMN_CD_NM ELSE T.ITEM_NM END AS itemNm , T.WRITING_DATE AS writingDate , T.WRITING_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd , DEPT.DEPT_NM AS writingDeptNm , T.WRITER_STF_NO AS writerStfNo , STF.STF_NM AS writerNm , T.KEY_ID AS keyId , T.PACT_ID AS pactId , T.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd , CASE WHEN T.SORT_SEQ = -99999 THEN NULL ELSE T.SORT_SEQ END AS sortSeq , T.NOTE , CASE WHEN T.PRINT_SEQ = -99999 THEN NULL ELSE T.PRINT_SEQ END AS printSeq , CASE WHEN T.MDRC_ID = -99999 THEN NULL ELSE T.MDRC_ID END AS mdrcId , CASE WHEN T.MDFM_ID = -99999 THEN NULL ELSE T.MDFM_ID END AS mdfmId , T.EXAM_KEY AS examKey , T.PACS_IMG_IPTN_CD AS pacsImgIptnCd , T.ACCS_ID AS accsId , T.RECTYPE AS recType , T.GENE_EXM_YN AS geneExmYn , T.MDRC_WRT_STS_CD_YN AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn , CASE WHEN T.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = -99999 THEN NULL ELSE T.MDRC_FOM_SEQ END AS mdrcFormSeq , T.OP_EXPT_REG_ID AS opExptRegId
FROM (
UNION ALL
UNION ALL
UNION ALL
) T
LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CCCCCSTE COMN ON T.COMN_CD = COMN.COMN_CD AND T.RECORD_TYPE = 'DR' AND COMN.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_PDEDBMSM DEPT ON T.WRITING_DEPT_CD = DEPT.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD STF ON T.WRITER_STF_NO = STF.STF_NO ORDER BY CASE WHEN T.RECORD_TYPE = 'NR' AND T.PACT_TP_CD = 'X' THEN '0001-01-01'::DATE ELSE T.WRITING_DATE END DESC , T.SORT_SEQ , DECODE(T.RECORD_TYPE, 'NR', T.WRITING_DATE, NULL) DESC
mapper.sql:
SELECT 'DR' AS RECORD_TYPE , A.MDFM_CLS_CD AS RECORD_DETAIL_TYPE , NULL AS ITEM_TYPE , NULL AS ITEM_NM , CASE WHEN A.MDFM_CLS_CD IN ('D001', 'D002', 'D003', 'D004', 'D031') THEN A.MED_DT ELSE A.MDF_REC_DTM END AS WRITING_DATE
, A.WRTR_DEPT_CD AS WRITING_DEPT_CD , NULL AS WRITING_DEPT_NM , A.WK_STF_NO AS WRITER_STF_NO , NULL AS WRITER_NM , NULL AS KEY_ID , A.PACT_ID AS PACT_ID , A.PACT_TP_CD AS PACT_TP_CD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_CHAR(A.MDF_REC_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY A.REC_DTM DESC) AS SORT_SEQ , NULL AS NOTE , A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS PRINT_SEQ , A.MDRC_ID , A.MDFM_ID , NULL AS EXAM_KEY , NULL AS PACS_IMG_IPTN_CD , NULL AS ACCS_ID , NULL AS RECTYPE , NULL AS GENE_EXM_YN , CASE WHEN A.MDRC_WRT_STS_CD > 10 THEN 'Y' END MDRC_WRT_STS_CD_YN , A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ , NULL AS OP_EXPT_REG_ID , A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD AS COMN_CD FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECM A WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.MDFM_CLS_CD NOT IN ('D005', 'D006') /* 수술, 퇴원 기록 제외 */ AND ((A.MDFM_CLS_CD IN ('D001', 'D002', 'D003', 'D004', 'D031') AND A.MED_DT::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE) OR (A.MDFM_CLS_CD NOT IN ('D001', 'D002', 'D003', 'D004', 'D031') AND A.MDF_REC_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE)) AND A.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd})
AND A.PT_MED_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WRTR_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WK_SID = #{writerStfNo} AND A.WK_STF_NO = #{writerStfNo}
AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.MDRC_DC_TP_CD = 'C' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ODS.S_MRFMFORM WHERE MDFM_ID = A.MDFM_ID AND MDFM_FOM_SEQ = A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ AND MDFM_CLS_CD = 'D020' AND MDFM_APY_CTRA_CD = 4) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 'Y' FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD W WHERE W.STF_NO = A.WRT_STF_NO AND W.OCTY_TP_CD IN ('Z06'))

SELECT 'DR' AS RECORD_TYPE , B.MDFM_CLS_CD AS RECORD_DETAIL_TYPE , NULL AS ITEM_TYPE , NULL AS ITEM_NM , A.OP_EXPT_DT AS WRITING_DATE , NULL AS WRITING_DEPT_CD , NULL AS WRITING_DEPT_NM , B.LSH_STF_NO AS WRITER_STF_NO , NULL AS WRITER_NM , NULL AS KEY_ID , NULL AS PACT_ID , NULL AS PACT_TP_CD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.OP_EXPT_DT ORDER BY A.OP_EXPT_DT DESC) AS SORT_SEQ , NULL AS NOTE , NULL AS PRINT_SEQ , NULL AS MDRC_ID , NULL AS MDFM_ID , NULL AS EXAM_KEY , NULL AS PACS_IMG_IPTN_CD , NULL AS ACCS_ID , NULL AS RECTYPE , NULL AS GENE_EXM_YN , 'Y' AS MDRC_WRT_STS_CD_YN , NULL AS MDRC_FOM_SEQ , A.OP_EXPT_REG_ID AS OP_EXPT_REG_ID , B.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD AS COMN_CD FROM ODS.S_MRDDRARD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRAFE B ON A.OP_EXPT_REG_ID = B.OP_EXPT_REG_ID AND B.AFCHG_ANRM_REC_VAL_ID IS NULL INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOOOPPAM C ON C.OP_EXPT_REG_ID = A.OP_EXPT_REG_ID WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.LSH_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND B.LSH_DTM = (SELECT MAX(LSH_DTM) FROM ODS.S_MRDDRAFE D WHERE D.OP_EXPT_REG_ID = B.OP_EXPT_REG_ID AND D.MDFM_CLS_CD = B.MDFM_CLS_CD AND D.AFCHG_ANRM_REC_VAL_ID IS NULL) GROUP BY B.MDFM_CLS_CD, B.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD, A.OP_EXPT_DT, B.LSH_STF_NO, A.OP_EXPT_REG_ID
